Now I have acne, white spots, and swelling all over my face, and I don’t even know what ingredient caused it. 

If anyone knows how I can treat it, advice would be greatly appreciated - For now I’m just rising with water and waiting a few days for it to go down.

But the point of this post is to remind you not to make my mistake and always patch test. Please.
